Samir / Neha — quick technical summary and artifacts attached. See below for the short statement you requested and a few clarifying notes.

Plain-English statement (copy/paste for DPIA):
Redwood Inference's hosted Console and web SDK operate with first-party telemetry by default. The Console collects aggregate usage metrics, anonymized error reports, and feature-usage events to maintain service quality. No third-party advertising cookies are set by Redwood's Console/SDK unless a customer explicitly configures third-party tag integrations (for example, enabling a BrightAd pixel via the client-side tag manager). When third-party tags are activated, any data sent to those third parties is controlled by the customer configuration and is outside Redwood's default data flows.

Redwood stores telemetry and logs in region-specific storage based on account configuration. For EU accounts, telemetry and analytics are retained in EU-based storage and processed by subprocessors with data centers in the EU or covered by standard contractual clauses for transfers. System logs required for debugging may be transferred to our operations subprocessor in the US when necessary for incident response, but access is limited and logged.

Attachments included (stubs):
- subprocessor_inventory.csv — list of subprocessors, their roles, and regions (EU-first for this account)
- dataflow-diagram.png — simple arrows showing client -> Redwood EU analytics -> (optional) third-party pixel endpoints
- dpa-template.pdf — standard DPA (already cc'd by Neha)

Clarifying notes:
- If you enable any marketing pixels via the client-side tag manager, those pixels may set third-party cookies and send identifiers directly to the third party. We recommend listing those third parties in the DPIA and confirming retention/transfer practices with them.
- For strict EU-only processing requirements we can provide an EU-only hosting plan (Private deployment or Dedicated with EU-only subprocessors) under an enterprise arrangement — let me know if that is required and we can escalate.

Rishi
